newsitem.title: USA: Block Drug to reduce workforce by 12 pct.
newsitem.headline: Block Drug to reduce workforce by 12 pct.

text.p: Block Drug Co Inc said Wednsday it planned to close six of its 12 production facilities during the next three years as part of a consolidation of its manufacturing operations.
The company said it would reduce its global workforce by 12 percent or 400 employees.

It expected to save about $25 million in annual costs -- money that it will reinvest to support its brands, recent acquisitions and new products. The money will also help strengthen its presence in major markets and enable it to try to enter new geographic areas. The company also said it planned to take a pre-tax charge of about $70 million in its fourth fiscal quarter from January to March, 1997 to cover the costs of restructuring and re-engineering.
"Management believes this consolidation is essential to the company's ability to compete in the global marketplace," it said.
A company spokesman said Block Drug would be closing its plants in South Brunswick, New Jersey, as well as Argentina, Australia, Belgium, Canada and Wales.
It said it would keep open its plants in Brazil, England, Ireland, Puerto Rico, Tennessee and Wisconsin.
"The date on which manufacturing will cease at each of the six locations will be determined on an individual basis in the near future.
